issues.description: kw_only_dataclass helper deleted but @dataclass_transform decoration lost at call sites
issues.detail: The removed kw_only_dataclass had @dataclass_transform(frozen_default=True, kw_only_default=True). Replacing it with bare @dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True) is functionally equivalent at runtime but loses the explicit decorator-as-data marker that tools/type-checkers used to understand these classes. This complects the transform contract with the dataclass call. Keep a single named transform or verify mypy/pyright still infers kw_only across all ~15 sites.

issues.description: default_raise() and 'default_factory=default_raise' remain after the < 3.10 reason vanished
issues.detail: default_raise exists explicitly 'for < 3.10 compatibility'. Now that 3.10 is the floor and kw_only is real, the field(default_factory=default_raise) pattern across dozens of request types is incidental complexity left over from a workaround. Without required fields needing defaults, these can become plain required kw_only fields. Decompose now or it ossifies.

issues.description: Blanket ignore of UP045/UP007/UP035 hides the actual modernization work this PR claims
issues.detail: The PR description says Union/Optional should become 'A | B' / 'A | None', but ruff.toml then ignores UP045, UP007, UP035 with a TODO. The stated value (drop 3.9 to simplify types) is decoupled from delivered change. Either land the codemod or don't advertise it; leaving an open-ended TODO complects intent with deferred work.

issues.description: Stale comment in wallet_request_types references '< 3.10 compatibility'
issues.detail: Around line 1227 the surviving comment still explains the default_factory=default_raise pattern as '(this is for < 3.10 compatibility)'. The reason is gone; the comment now misleads future readers about why the pattern exists. Either delete the pattern or update the rationale to the real one (required kw_only field with no default).

issues.description: install.sh version check lower bound still permits 3.7-3.9
issues.detail: find_python loop now starts at 3.12 and ends at bare '3', but the guard 'PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7' still accepts 3.7/3.8/3.9 if a bare 'python3' resolves there. The error message was updated to '>= 3.10' but the predicate wasn't. Value (minimum version) and check (predicate) are complected with the message; align them.

issues.description: test-install-scripts adds noisy 'dnf search' to production-like prep steps
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky prep now runs 'dnf update -y' and 'dnf search python3.12' before install. 'search' is interactive diagnostic noise that doesn't affect the install; 'update -y' on every CI run is slow and changes the test substrate. Keep the prep deterministic: install only what's required.

review.summary: The PR drops Python 3.9 and removes version-gated shims, which is a real simplification — the kw_only_dataclass helper, sys.version_info branches, and 3.9-only poetry lock entries are gone. But the change is half-done: the typing modernization it advertises (Union -> |, Optional -> | None) is gated off in ruff.toml as TODO, and the default_raise / field(default_factory=default_raise) pattern that existed only to work around < 3.10 still pervades wallet_request_types.py. install.sh updates the error string but not the version predicate. The bones are SIMPLE-er; the meat is EASY-NOT-SIMPLE — finish removing the 3.9 fingerprints before the next person treats them as load-bearing.
